label: Matthew-Mark Cross-Translation Validation
description: Standing validation collection: Matthew+Mark subtexts from the Douay-Rheims (1582-1610) and the 1599 Geneva Bible. Cross-translation ground truth for all Palimpsest similarity/masking validation.
copyright_note: Source text bodies are copyrighted-edition scripture (DR 2018 reprint / Geneva Tolle Lege 2013). Per repo convention (imports/ gitignored; no reference.txt committed) the bodies are NOT committed. Regenerate locally from imports/ with build.py; assert with validate.py.
parity_note: Geneva 1749 vs DR 1747 verses (+1 Matthew, +1 Mark) reflects genuine Vulgate-vs-Protestant versification differences — intended cross-translation variance, not an error.
